task: Generate one photorealistic still frame that looks like a paused vertical video a real woman recorded of herself with her iPhone front camera, sitting in the driver's seat of her parked luxury car, to talk to her audience. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it must be indistinguishable from a real phone recording.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

subject.identity: an original, non-famous Latin American woman, 30 years old
subject.face: warm light-olive skin with natural texture (visible pores, tiny natural imperfections, faint expression lines), dark brown eyes, soft natural makeup, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: long dark brown hair with soft natural waves, parted slightly to one side, a few loose strands framing the face
subject.accessories: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold necklace, no sunglasses, no other jewelry

wardrobe.top: fitted cream-colored fine-knit sweater with a round neckline, soft fabric with natural folds and wrinkles, seatbelt not fastened
wardrobe.style: elegant smart casual, polished and approachable, nothing flashy, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: seated in the driver's seat of the parked car, upper body turned square to the phone and leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural half-smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted, relaxed jaw
pose_and_expression.hands: both hands resting relaxed on the lower part of the steering wheel at the bottom of the frame, fingers natural, all fingers anatomically correct and fully visible

environment.location: inside her modern luxury car, parked, during the day
environment.background: premium cream leather seats with fine stitching, the dark headrest behind her, the side window and the rear seats softly visible, outside the windows a calm tree-lined street softly out of focus, uncluttered; no people outside
environment.foreground: the top of a leather steering wheel at the bottom edge of the frame, slightly out of focus, with no brand emblem visible
environment.atmosphere: clean, real, lived-in luxury car interior, not a staged studio set

camera.device: iPhone front camera mounted on the dashboard near the windshield, at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; her head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean space with the car headliner and seat above her head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused frontal daylight coming through the windshield directly in front of her, behind the phone, lighting her whole face evenly from the front; the car is parked in open shade, so there is no direct sunlight
lighting.fill: soft ambient daylight bouncing off the cream leather interior
lighting.mood: bright, clean and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit with the same brightness and no side shadows, only very soft natural shading under the chin and nose; accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: must look like a real person recorded on a phone, not AI-generated and not a stock photo
real skin texture, no smoothing, no beauty filter, no plastic or waxy skin
natural fabric folds and wrinkles on the sweater
correct human anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions
realistic eyes with natural catchlights from the windshield in front of her
even, symmetrical illumination on the face, as when someone films herself facing the windshield
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements
car brand emblems or badges, readable screens or dashboard text
side lighting, split lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, harsh direct sunlight, strong shadows on one side of the face, sunlight through the side window on the face
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, asymmetrical eyes, warped face
smooth or airbrushed skin, heavy makeup, 3D render, cartoon, illustration, CGI look
sunglasses, flashy clothes, visible brand logos
the car driving, motion blur, cluttered interior, other people, mirrors showing other faces
a likeness of any real or famous person
